//: Opt-in type check for the build and data-pull scripts: `npm run check:scripts`.
NOT part of `npm run verify`, deliberately. A first pass found 11 errors and zero
real bugs: every one was TypeScript widening a heterogeneous array literal (for
example [['detail', VARS], ['subject', VARS]] infers string|string[], so .join()
looks unsafe when it is not). Silencing those needs JSDoc annotations throughout
scripts/, which is worth doing when someone next works in there, not before.
A gate that always fails is a gate everyone learns to ignore.
